summary: Scholar Rock Holding Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement to increase shares available under an existing Open Market Sale Agreement with Jefferies LLC to $200,000,000. The company has already sold shares of common stock with aggregate net proceeds of approximately $257.7 million under prior agreements and no further shares will be sold under the prior supplement. The offering is an at-the-market issuance under Rule 415(a)(4), with Jefferies acting as sales agent and receiving up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. There is no escrow arrangement. This is a routine shelf takedown to raise capital, not a special situation.
